coordinate_rule: patch polygons are in the referenced panel local XY millimetres; front/back lies at local Z=+/-thickness/2 and transforms through that actual panel pose
admission_rules: both panels and explicit active steps exist in this Job; IDs and references unique and scoped
each patch is a finite simple polygon with positive area contained in its selected panel face; holes not representable by this carrier
normal_overlap_limit_mm is finite and nonnegative, has explicit basis and does not grant pair-wide penetration
FixedConnection.allow_contact=false requires no contact references; true requires actual local references for that connection pair
glue output consumes the exact declared face patch; absent/invalid patch is a missing manufacturing input, not an invented rectangle
engage_after_step_id=null means active in the initial assembly; otherwise activation only at successful completion of the referenced forming step, after checking both connection frames
after activation both frames must satisfy position/angle closure tolerance; a remaining free hinge cannot silently contradict the fixed bond

0 <= normal_overlap_limit_mm < min(actual thickness of both panels); do not clamp a full-thickness allowance. For each panel pair and active step, the allowance union must leave positive-volume unlicensed residual in both panels.
process_rule: during each permitted step only overlap inside both matched transformed patches and the explicit allowed normal extent can use this allowance
outside either patch remains part of the ordinary solid collision check; neither allow_contact nor a pair ID exempts whole panels
interval proof must cover patch membership and overlap bound for the whole interval; unknown boundary or insufficient budget stays Undetermined
legacy_input_rule: old pair-only contacts require explicit PREP-PACKAGING mapping and user-declared patch/allowed extent; no automatic whole-face patch; empty contacts remain empty
manufacturing_rule: 生效端点的双面patch实际共同投影映回应用板flat_pose，只在panel_a输出一次glue；连接frames不决定面积，缺区域/斜交不可靠保持Undetermined。

interval_method.volume: 指定面局部polygon向本体内部延伸批准深度，0≤d<两板实际厚度最小值，不截成t；同一pair/step的区域联合须在两板都留下正体积未许可残余。
interval_method.partition: 按patch边/Z层切成凸单元，标签为同一有效双面许可ID集合
interval_method.accept: 两单元共享同一个有效许可ID才允许其交集；其他单元对全区间证明分离
interval_method.unknown: 裁剪/归属/阈值未定或预算不足保持Undetermined，不扩大patch
